title: evals/scenarios/<name>.script.json
description: Canned turns the scripted driver replays in order.

tokens.description: Defaults to the text's length divided by 4, rounded up.

sl.description: sl commands to run in the working root before the turn is recorded, each as its arguments without --root.

write.description: Files the skill writes by hand before its sl commands run, by path relative to the working root (such as goldens/<name>.yaml) to their text. Never under .sl/, never outside the root or through a link, always valid YAML, and never with status: approved or an approval field.

agent.description: A task the interviewer turn before it dispatched to this role agent (multi-agent scenarios): its sl commands run through the role guard, it writes nothing and never ends the session.

fill.description: Review forms the owner fills in and hands back with this turn: each form sl review export wrote, with the owner's verdict and words per item, written in as a person fills in the form.

form.description: The form the skill wrote, such as .sl/reviews/rb_0001.md.

as.description: Where the owner hands it back, under shared/ in the working root, in the form's format.

items.description: The item's target -> the owner's verdict and words; an item left out stays unanswered.

questions.description: Text an open question of the form holds -> the owner's answer; a question left out stays unanswered.
